text: The building cap increased by 100% from $150,000 to $300,000, and the levy rate was reduced by 20% from 20 cents to 16 cents per $100 of EQCover. The maximum EQCover levy is now $480 for homes insured above $300,000. Most policyholders are expected to see higher total EQCover levies despite the lower rate due to the larger coverage base.

metadata.solution_name: Doubling of the Residential Building Cap and Levy Adjustment under EQCover (Toka Tū Ake EQC)
